title: Google brings Gemini Pro to Bard in more than 40 languages and over 230 countries and territories
summary: Google announced on 1 February 2024 that Gemini Pro would power Bard worldwide in more than 40 languages.

title: AI Incident Database lists a deepfake-enabled scam reported to have cost a company USD 25 million
summary: A deepfake-enabled scam reportedly cost a company USD 25 million.

title: CTV: Canada's government intends to cover sexually explicit deepfakes in its online harms bill
summary: Canada planned federal legislation targeting the sharing of non-consensual sexually explicit AI-generated images.

title: AI Incident Database lists alleged deepfake audio of Imran Khan urging an election boycott
summary: The alleged deepfake audio reportedly misled Pakistani voters ahead of the general election.

title: AI Incident Database lists a deepfake video falsely claiming Kyiv planned to assassinate President Macron
summary: The video made a false claim about a Ukrainian plot against the French president.

title: AI Incident Database lists deepfake audio attributing controversial remarks to Keir Starmer
summary: The audio falsely attributed remarks about the Rochdale by-election crisis to the Labour leader.

title: Google introduces Gemini 1.5 Pro with a context window of up to one million tokens
summary: Gemini 1.5 uses a mixture-of-experts architecture and a multimodal design.

title: OpenAI presents Sora, a model that generates realistic videos of up to one minute from text, El Mundo reports
summary: OpenAI showed Sora's output in a first public preview and did not release the model to the public.

title: AI Incident Database lists nonconsensual deepfake pornography of Bobbi Althoff spreading on X
summary: The nonconsensual deepfake material spread rapidly on X.

title: AI Incident Database lists a ChatGPT glitch that gave users nonsensical outputs
summary: A ChatGPT glitch reportedly caused users to receive nonsensical outputs.

title: Google releases Gemma, a family of smaller open-weight models based on Gemini research
summary: Gemma was released in 2B and 7B sizes for developers, with openly available weights.

title: Google pauses Gemini's image generation of people after criticism over historically inaccurate images
summary: Users reported inaccurate depictions of people in historical contexts, and Google suspended the feature after the criticism.

title: Air Street newsletter: Nvidia crosses USD 2 trillion in market value for the first time
summary: The newsletter reports the milestone on 23 February, days after earnings showed a 265 percent year-on-year revenue jump driven by AI.

title: India's government confronts Google over Gemini answers about Narendra Modi, The Guardian reports
summary: Gemini reportedly said Modi had been accused of implementing fascist policies, without similar answers for Trump or Zelensky, according to the Spanish Wikipedia account.

title: Mistral AI launches Mistral Large and announces a partnership with Microsoft to offer its models on Azure
summary: Mistral Large is a proprietary model available on Microsoft Azure, announced alongside a multi-year partnership.

title: AP report finds Gemini and other chatbots gave false or misleading answers about US elections
summary: The report said the chatbots generated false information that could disenfranchise voters.

title: AI Incident Database lists deepfake nude images of classmates allegedly made by Beverly Hills middle school students
summary: Students at a Beverly Hills middle school allegedly created and shared deepfake nude images of classmates.

title: Alibaba leads a USD 1 billion round in Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI at a USD 2.5 billion valuation, Bloomberg reports
summary: Moonshot AI is the Beijing developer of the Kimi chatbot.

title: Elon Musk sues OpenAI and Sam Altman, alleging a shift from public benefit to profit maximisation
summary: OpenAI called the suit incoherent and frivolous.

title: EU member states unanimously approve the final text of the AI Act
summary: Ambassadors of the 27 EU countries endorsed the AI Act text agreed in December, clearing the way for formal adoption.

title: Japan launches its AI Safety Institute within the Information-technology Promotion Agency (IPA)
summary: The institute was set up to study AI safety evaluation methods and standards in coordination with partner institutes abroad.

title: Putin signs Decree No. 124 amending Russia's National AI Development Strategy to 2030
summary: The presidential decree of 15 February 2024 updates the national AI strategy with new goals for AI development and adoption through 2030.

title: China's SASAC tells central state firms to launch an 'AI+' action and build intelligent computing centres
summary: At a special meeting on AI for central SOEs, SASAC called for computing centres and industrial datasets, and 10 central SOEs pledged to open AI application scenarios.

title: Krutrim launches its chatbot, built on models covering more than 20 Indian languages, GKToday reports
summary: About a month after its USD 1 billion valuation round, Krutrim opened its chatbot, whose models understand over 20 Indian languages and generate text in 10.

title: Vedomosti: Russian authorities plan to introduce penalties for deepfakes, Meduza reports
summary: According to Vedomosti, Russian authorities are preparing legal liability for the use of deepfake technology.

title: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court bans deepfakes in 2024 election campaigns and requires labels on AI content
summary: The TSE resolution prohibits altering candidates' images or voices, restricts chatbots and avatars, requires notice of AI use and makes platforms liable for failing to remove harmful content.
